headings.title: Temporary convention license requirements

headings.title: Fourteen-day nonrenewable temporary license

headings.title: Foreign applicants and Social Security number

headings.title: Insurance certificates for housemover licenses

headings.title: Continuous coverage and vehicle list
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: certificates provide continuous coverage during the license period; current vehicle list filed with certificate; amendments within fifteen days of changes.

headings.title: Insurer notice of cancellation or changes

headings.title: Surety bond or cargo insurance filing

headings.title: Special permit for housemovers on state highways
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1 and three conditions: licensed housemovers need a § 304.200 special permit from the chief engineer for every move on the state highway system; issued if the chief engineer determines proper licensure, required bond or cargo insurance under § 324.712(4), and other required regulations compliance. Source history: L. 2001 H.B. 567 merged with S.B. 317.

headings.title: Own-house exception and permit requirement
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: no license for individuals moving their own houses between property they individually own, but a special permit is required for all moves.

headings.title: Escort vehicle requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 3: one rear escort on interstate and other divided highways; two escorts (front and rear) on multilane and two-lane highways.

headings.title: Permit application timing

headings.title: Travel plan and route review
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: travel plan with route, segment times, and traffic plan limiting delay to twenty minutes; permit not issued if route cannot accommodate weight or size limits or causes undue interruption. headings.title: Alternate plans and hardship appeals

headings.title: Division rules for electrical licensing
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: division adopts and administers rules to carry out §§ 324.900–324.945, with examples (conduct, continuing competency, ethical standards), chapter 536 compliance, and nonseverability with invalidity for rules after August 28, 2017. headings.title: Division duties and electrical fund

headings.title: Terminating recognition of certifying entities

headings.title: Statewide electrical contractor license requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1 and four requirements: $500,000 liability insurance and local bonds as required, standardized accredited examination, examination cost, and one of four verifiable practical hours and credential options (a)–(d). Source history: L. 2017 S.B. 240, A.L. 2018 H.B. 1719 merged with S.B. 840 merged with S.B. 862.

headings.title: License eligibility for local contractors
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2 and four conditions: holders of local contractor or master electrician licenses are eligible if they show a qualifying examination, twelve thousand hours or six of previous eight years' licensure, insurance, and current local license not subject to discipline; applies only to licenses from subdivisions with legal authority.

headings.title: Supervisory licensed contractor requirement
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 3: entities engaging in licensed electrical contracting must employ at a supervisory level at least one statewide licensed electrical contractor, who may represent only one entity at a time.

headings.title: Local-license operators not required to hold statewide license
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 4: persons operating in a subdivision that does not require a local license, or who hold the required local license, are not required to hold a statewide license to continue there.

headings.title: Recognition of statewide license by localities

headings.title: Complaints and sales tax withholding
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: statewide licensee complaint to division, investigation, thirty-day notice to comply, and withholding of local sales tax under § 32.085 by the department of revenue until compliance; withheld money not state funds.

headings.title: Local powers not prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 3 and eight listed local actions (enforcing codes, electrical code based on NEC, local licenses, business licenses, permits, inspection, licensing electricians based on experience and an accredited examination).

headings.title: No new local licensing authority
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 4: political subdivisions without authority to issue or require electrical licenses before August 28, 2017 are not granted such authority by this section.

headings.title: Requested inactive status

headings.title: Permit clearance when changing employers

headings.title: Local suspension of work pending complaint
